z-m-20-01.title: Ingaba isixa samabinzana amabini equadratiki sihlala sibinzana lequadratiki?
z-m-20-01.goal: Cacisa ukuba idigri itshintsha njani kwisixa nakwimveliso yeepholinomiyali, uhlula iimeko ngemizekelo echasayo nezizathu.
z-m-20-01.material: Iipholinomiyali A noB zombini ziintetho zekhwadratiki kwi-x. Oko kuthetha ukuba ikoyifishenti ye-x² ayingo-0 (funda: x² "x squared"), kwaye onke amakoyifishenti ayinani langempela. Idigri yidigri yegama eliphezulu elikoyifishenti yalo ingeyo-0. Ngokomzekelo, x²+3x yintetho yekhwadratiki kwaye u-2 une-digri ye-0. Asiyi kucinga ngemeko apho A+B okanye A−B ingu-0 ngokwayo. U-Seoyeon wathi, "Ukuba udibanisa iintetho zekhwadratiki, ufumana intetho yekhwadratiki, kwaye ukuba uziphindaphinda, ufumana intetho yedigri ye-4."
z-m-20-01.thinking.1: Thelekisa isixa nemveliso uze ucinge ukuba yeyiphi enokulahlekelwa ligama ledigri ephezulu
z-m-20-01.prereq.0: I-H1 kulo msebenzi ibonisa kuphela ubunzima nenqanaba lenkxaso yale batch yemveliso; ayiyo indawo yebanga kwikharityhulam. Cinga ukuba uyayazi ukudibanisa, ukukhupha nokuphindaphinda iipholinomiyali zesikolo samabanga aphakathi, iifomyula zokuphindaphinda, nokuhlela ngokusisiseko.
z-m-20-01.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yedigri negama ledigri ephezulu lepholinomiyali
z-m-20-01.s.s1.prompt: Xa A noB beyintetho zekhwadratiki ezanelisa imeko engasentla, khetha zonke izitatimenti ezinyanisileyo rhoqo nokuba ukhetha iintetho zekhwadratiki ezimbini ezithile.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ukuba isitatimenti sinyanisile rhoqo, kufuneka sisebenze nakweyiphi na ibini leentetho zekhwadratiki ozifakayo. Khetha iintetho zekhwadratiki ezimbini ezilula, uzidibanise uze uziphindaphinde, uze uhlole idigri.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwisivakalisi ngasinye, zama ukukhetha A noB ezenza ukuba isivakalisi sibe ngamanga, kwaye ukuba awukwazi ukuzikhetha, bhala ukuba kutheni.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.a: Uthe "rhoqo" ungavavanyanga imeko apho isixa samakoyifishenti e-x² singu-0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigwebo sibona ukuba ukudibanisa kudibanisa kuphela amakoyifishenti amagama edigri efanayo, ngoko akukho gama litsha ledigri ephezulu livelayo.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.c: Esi sigwebo siqwalasela ukuba ngawaphi amagama amabini aphindaphindwa ukwenza igama ledigri ephezulu yemveliso.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.d: Ucinge ukuba igama ledigri ephezulu liyanyamalala xa ukhupha. Linyamalala kuphela xa amakoyifishenti amabini e-x² elingana. Ngokomzekelo, ukuba A=x² noB=2x², ngoko A−B=−x².
z-m-20-01.s.s1.o.e: Ikoyifishenti yegama le-x⁴ kuA×B inokuba ngu-0.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.r.e: Uthwele oko kwenzeka kwisixa kwimveliso njengoko kunjalo. Cinga ukuba ikoyifishenti yegama ledigri ephezulu yemveliso yenziwa njani.
z-m-20-01.s.s1.explain: b no-c zisebenza kuyo nayiphi na ibini leentetho zekhwadratiki. a iyaphuka xa isixa samakoyifishenti amabini e-x² singu-0, kwaye d iyaphuka xa amakoyifishenti amabini e-x² eyahlukile. Kutheni e ingasebenzi kuyinto oza kuyicacisa wena kwinyathelo lokugqibela.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.prompt: Vumela A=ax²+bx+1 noB=cx²+dx+2 (a, b, c, d ziinani zangempela). Yenza imizekelo emibini enentetho ezahlukileyo apho A noB zombini ziintetho zekhwadratiki kodwa A+B ayiyiyo intetho yekhwadratiki.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ubhale ukuba ikoyifishenti yegama le-x² kuA+B inokuvezwa njani usebenzisa a no-c.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha a ukuze le koyifishenti ibe ngu-0 uze uhambelanise c nayo. Emva koko khetha b no-d ngokukhululekileyo uze udibanise ukuhlola.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Ukuba ikoyifishenti ye-x² a ka-A ingu-0, ngoko A ayiyiyo intetho yekhwadratiki.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuba ikoyifishenti ye-x² c ka-B ingu-0, ngoko B ayiyiyo intetho yekhwadratiki.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Likho igama le-x² elisalayo kuA+B. Fumana ikoyifishenti ye-x² ka-A+B uze uhlole.
z-m-20-01.s.s2.explain: Ngokomzekelo, ukuba A=x²+2x+1 noB=−x²+5x+2, ngoko A+B=7x+3, eyintetho eqondileyo. Ukuba A=2x²+3x+1 noB=−2x²+3x+2, ngoko A+B=6x+3. Zombini iintetho zikhwadratiki, kodwa ukuba isixa samakoyifishenti e-x² singu-0, isixa asiyiyo intetho yekhwadratiki. Ngoko "ukudibanisa iintetho zekhwadratiki kunika intetho yekhwadratiki" akunyaniso rhoqo.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.prompt: Phakathi kwamabango ka-Seoyeon, "ukudibanisa kunika intetho yekhwadratiki" kwaphulwa, kodwa "ukuphindaphinda kunika intetho yedigri ye-4" akuphulwanga. Bhala ngamagama akho ukuba kutheni igama ledigri ephezulu lingenakunyamalala kwimveliso, uthelekisa nesixa.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.0: Fumana ukuba leliphi igama likuA noleliphi likuB elifuneka liphindaphindwe ukwenza igama le-x⁴ kuA×B.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ikoyifishenti ye-x² ka-A+B yi-a+c. Bhala ukuba ikoyifishenti ye-x⁴ ka-A×B ivela njani, uze uthelekise ezi zimbini.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ngamagama akho ukuba kutheni igama ledigri ephezulu lingaphela kwisixa (amakoyifishenti adibana abe ngu-0)?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale ukuba ngawaphi amagama amabini aphindaphindwa ukwenza igama ledigri ephezulu yemveliso?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba usebenzise inyaniso yokuba imveliso yamanani amabini angengo-0 ayingo-0 njengesizathu?
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.0: Kwisixa, sidibanisa amakoyifishenti e-x², kwaye a+c inokuba ngu-0, ngoko igama le-x² linokunyamalala. Kwimveliso, ikoyifishenti yegama ledigri ephezulu yi-ac, imveliso ka-a no-c. Ukuba a no-c zombini azingo-0, ac nayo ayingo-0, ngoko igama le-x⁴ lihlala lisala.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.1: Xa siphindaphinda, imveliso yamagama edigri ephezulu yigama le-x⁴, kwaye leyo yeyona mveliso kuphela yenza igama le-x⁴, ngoko akukho gama elinye elilirhoxisayo. Ikoyifishenti nayo yimveliso yamanani angengo-0, ngoko ayingo-0. Kwisixa, + kunye ne-− zinokudibana zenze u-0, ngoko igama linokunyamalala, kodwa oko akunakwenzeka kwimveliso.
z-m-20-01.s.s3.model.2: Umzekelo, kwi-(x²+1)(−x²+2), igama elilodwa le-x⁴ yi-x²×(−x²)=−x⁴, kwaye ikoyefishenti yalo −1 ayingu-0, ngoko libinzana lebanga lesi-4. Kwisixa (x²+1)+(−x²+2), ikoyefishenti ye-x² yi-1+(−1)=0, ngoko igama le-x² lanyamalala.

Cinga ukuba uyayazi ukudibanisa, ukukhupha nokuphindaphinda iipholinomiyali zesikolo samabanga aphakathi, iifomyula zokuphindaphinda, nokuhlela ngokusisiseko.
z-m-20-02.title: Libinzana elithini elinexabiso elimiselwe sisixa kuphela?
z-m-20-02.topic: Iifomyula zokuphindaphinda namaxabiso amabinzana: amanani amabini anesixa esinikiweyo
z-m-20-02.goal: Nquma ukuba libinzana elithini elinexabiso elinye xa kuphela isixa a+b samanani amabini siyaziwa, uze wahlule ulwazi olongezelelweyo olonelisayo kolo olungonelisi ukumisela ixabiso.
z-m-20-02.material: Kumanani amabini aphelele a no-b, konke okwaziwayo kukuba a+b=6. Akukho nto ithi a no-b ngamanani apheleleyo, kwaye akukho nto ithi bapositive. Sifuna ukubona ukuba ngawaphi amaxabiso amabinzana esinokuwafumana ngaphandle kokufumana a no-b ngokwahlukileyo. Ukufunda: a² yi-"a isikwere", ab yi-"a iphindwe ngo-b", kwaye a³ yi-"a ikyubhu".
z-m-20-02.thinking.1: Ukwenza imizekelo yakho echasayo (isixa esifanayo, amaxabiso ahlukileyo)
z-m-20-02.thinking.3: Ukuchaza isigqibo esinomqathango (isikwere simisiwe kodwa uphawu alumisiwe)
z-m-20-02.prereq.3: Amava okuguqula amabinzana ngaphandle kokufumana amaxabiso amanani apheleleyo a no-b ngokwahlukileyo
z-m-20-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amabinzana anexabiso elimiselwe kwixabiso elinye yinyaniso yokuba a+b=6 kuphela.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kwibinzana ngalinye olikhethileyo, faka ubhanxa ababini abahlukileyo (a, b) abanelisa a+b=6 uthelekise ukuba amaxabiso ayafana na.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumabinzana anamaxabiso afanayo, jonga ukuba ungawahlela ukuze a+b ivele kwibinzana njengoko injalo.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.a: Ixabiso lingatshintsha ngokuxhomekeke kwindlela a no-b abahlula ngayo isixa, kwaye awukuvavanyanga oko. Faka a=3, b=3 no-a=0, b=6 uthelekise.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigqibo sibona ukuba isixa a+b siqulathwe kwibinzana njengeqela elinye.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.c: Nokuba isixa sifanayo, uphawu lomahluko lunokutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni a inkulu okanye b inkulu, kwaye uphosile oko.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.d: Esi sigqibo siqaphele ibinzana njengemilo yefomyula yokuphindaphinda.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.r.e: 2a+2b imisiwe kodwa a²+b² ayimiselwanga, ngoko isixa asimiselwanga nasco. Ucinge ukuba ukuba inxalenye enye imisiwe, isonke simisiwe.
z-m-20-02.s.s1.explain: 2a+2b=2(a+b)=12 kwaye a²+2ab+b²=(a+b)²=36. a²+b² yi-18 ukuba a=3, b=3 kwaye yi-36 ukuba a=0, b=6, ngoko ayimiselwanga. a−b nayo yi-2 ukuba a=4, b=2 kwaye yi-−2 ukuba a=2, b=4.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza ubhanxa abathathu (a, b) abanga-a+b=6 apho amaxabiso e-a²+b² onke ahlukile. (a, b) kunye (b, a) babalwa njengobhanxa omnye.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ukhethe a, misela b ibe yi-6−a, uze ubale a²+b² ngqo.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.hint.1: Ukubona ukuba amaxabiso ayahluka na, khetha amaxabiso ahlukileyo e-a, afana no-0, 1, 2, uze uthelekise.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a+b ayiyi-6. Yongeza amanani amabini ujonge.
z-m-20-02.s.s2.explain: Kwi-(1, 5), a²+b²=26; kwi-(2, 4), yi-20; kwi-(3, 3), yi-18; kwaye kwi-(0, 6), yi-36. Nokuba isixa sifanayo, amaxabiso e-a²+b² ayahluka. (1, 5) kunye (5, 1) zinayo a²+b² efanayo, ngoko zibalwa njengomzekelo omnye.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.prompt: Ukongeza kwi-a+b=6, yeyiphi kwimiqathango engezantsi eyayiza kumisela ixabiso le-a²+b² kwixabiso elinye? Khetha zonke ezonelayo. (a no-b ngamanani apheleleyo anyanisekileyo)
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.0: Kwinketho nganye, cinga ukuba loo mqathango kunye no-a+b=6 ukuvumela ukuba ufumane a, b, okanye ab.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kumqathango ongenciphisi abagqatswa babe nye, jonga ukuba ubhanxa ababini abane-a²+b² eyahlukileyo (umzekelo, (1, 5) kunye (2, 4)) bobabini banelisa loo mqathango.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.a: Ukuba a linani eliphelele, kusala amathuba amaninzi, afana no-a=1 no-a=2, kwaye awuvavanyanga ukuba ixabiso limiselwe.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.b: Esi sigqibo sibona ukuba ukuba uyazi isixa nemveliso, ungavezela a²+b² usebenzisa isixa nemveliso.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.c: Umqathango woqwalaselo wehlisa abagqatswa kodwa awubanciphisi babe nye. a=1, b=5 no-a=2, b=4 bobabini bapositive.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.d: Esi sigqibo sisebenzisa inyaniso yokuba ukuba uyazi a+b no-a−b, ungafumana a no-b ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.r.e: Esi sigqibo sibona ukuba isixa seekyubhu sinokuvezwa ngesixa nemveliso, ngoko imveliso ab inokufumaneka.
z-m-20-02.s.s3.explain: Ukuba ab=8, ngoko a²+b²=(a+b)²−2ab=36−16=20. Ukuba a−b=2, ngoko a=4 no-b=2, ngoko yi-20. Ukusuka kwi-a³+b³=(a+b)³−3ab(a+b)=216−18ab=144, sifumana ab=4, ngoko a²+b²=36−8=28. Umqathango onje ngokuba linani eliphelele okanye ukuba ipositive wehlisa kuphela abagqatswa kwaye awubanciphisi babe nye.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.prompt: Xa a+b=6 no-ab=8, umhlobo wathi, "a−b nayo imiselwe kwixabiso elinye." Uyavumelana? Bhala impendulo yakho ngezizathu.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.0: Fumana amanani amabini athile isixa sawo esiyi-6 nemveliso yawo yi-8, ubale a−b.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.hint.1: Thelekisa oko kwenzekayo ku-a−b ukuba utshintshisa amagama a no-b amanani amabini owafumeneyo.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ingaba unike isizathu ngokuthi (a−b)² yintoni, okanye ngokusebenzisa ubhanxa abathile afana no-a=4, b=2 no-a=2, b=4?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale ngokucacileyo ukuba a−b inokuba namaxabiso amabini (uphawu)?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uhlule ukuba isikwere (a−b)² simisiwe kodwa a−b ngokwayo ayimiselwanga?
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.0: Andivumelani. (a−b)²=(a+b)²−4ab=36−32=4, ngoko a−b yi-2 okanye i-−2. Leyo ingeyiphi ixhomekeke kulandelelwano luka-a no-b, ngoko ayimiselwanga kwixabiso elinye.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.1: Ukuba a=4, b=2, ngoko a−b=2, kwaye ukuba a=2, b=4, ngoko a−b=−2, kwaye kuzo zombini iimeko isixa si-6 nemveliso i-8. Ngoko a−b ayimiselwanga kwixabiso elinye, kwaye isikwere (a−b)²=4 kuphela simisiwe.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.2: Ixabiso elipheleleyo le-2 kuphela limisiwe. Nokuba isixa nemveliso zifanayo, ukutshintshisa a no-b kutshintsha uphawu luka-a−b, ngoko i-−2 iyenzeka nayo, kwaye ayilo ixabiso elinye kuphela.
z-m-20-02.s.s4.model.3: Andivumelani. a−b yi-2 okanye i-−2. (a−b)²=4 kuphela emiselweyo.

z-m-20-05.title: Singazazi ntoni ngeekoyifishenti ngaphandle kokwandisa?
z-m-20-05.topic: Ukufumana izixa zeekoyifishenti ngokubeka amaxabiso e-x
z-m-20-05.goal: Ngaphandle kokwandisa intetho, wahlula ulwazi malunga neekoyifishenti onokulwazi ngamaxabiso ku-x=0, 1, −1 nolwazi ongenakulwazi, fumana ulungise impazamo kwisisombululo, uze ubonise ukuba ii-polynomial ezininzi zinolwazi olufanayo.
z-m-20-05.material: Ukuba wandisa ngokupheleleyo i-P(x)=(x²−x−1)³, iba yintetho yezinga lesi-6 enamalungu ukusuka kwi-x⁶ ukuya kwilungu eliqhelekileyo. Ukufunda: P(x) yi "x isikwere ukususa x ukususa 1, ngaphakathi kwamabakaki, kuphakanyiswe kwikyubhu". Sifuna ukufumana ulwazi malunga neekoyifishenti ngaphandle kokwandisa. P(0), P(1), kunye ne-P(−1) zinokufumaneka lula ngokubeka ngqo kumabakaki. Siza kubhala intetho eyandisiweyo njenge-P(x)=a₆x⁶+a₅x⁵+a₄x⁴+a₃x³+a₂x²+a₁x+a₀ (ukufunda: a₆ yi "a isithandathu", kwaye inani elingezantsi ligama elibonisa izinga).
z-m-20-05.thinking.0: Ukutolika ukuba ixabiso elibekiweyo lidibaniso luni lweekoyifishenti
z-m-20-05.thinking.2: Ukuyila ii-polynomial ezininzi ezanelisa iimeko ezifanayo
z-m-20-05.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yexabiso xa x=1, x=−1, x=0 zibekwa kwi-polynomial (ixabiso le-polynomial)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke izinto onokuzifumana usebenzisa amaxabiso amathathu kuphela P(0), P(1), P(−1) (ngaphandle kokwandisa).
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala ukuba lixabiso lini ilungu ngalinye aₖxᵏ xa ubeka 0, 1, −1 ku-x, wahlule ityala apho k iyipheyiri kwelo apho k ingqabangqaba.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kukhetho ngalunye, bhala ukuba lidibaniso luni lamaxabiso amathathu P(0), P(1), P(−1) elinika elo xabiso, kwaye ukuba alinakuvezwa, yenza umzekelo ochasayo ngepolynomial elula.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.a: Amaxabiso amathathu lulwazi malunga nezixa ezithile zeekoyifishenti kuphela. Awuzange uvavanye ukuba ikoyifishenti yelungu elinye inokwaziwa ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.b: Esi sigwebo sijonga ukuba lelipi ilungu eliseleyo xa ubeka 0 ku-x.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.c: Esi sigwebo sibona ukuba iimpawu zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba ziyahluka njani ku-x=1 nakwi-x=−1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.o.d: Ikoyifishenti a₆ ye-x⁶ (ikoyifishenti yelungu lezinga eliphezulu)
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.d: Unokuxela ilungu lezinga eliphezulu ngokujonga isakhiwo sentetho, kodwa la maxabiso amathathu wodwa awalungisi. Awuzange wahlule ukuba yeyiphi ulwazi ingxaki ivumela.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.r.e: Esi sigwebo sibona ukuba xa ubeka x=1, onke amandla e-x aba ngu-1.
z-m-20-05.s.s1.explain: P(0)=a₀, P(1)=isixa seekoyifishenti zonke, kwaye P(1)−P(−1)=2(isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba). Ikoyifishenti a₃ yelungu elinye okanye ikoyifishenti a₆ yelungu lezinga eliphezulu ayilungiswa ngala maxabiso amathathu wodwa (ukuba ujonga isakhiwo ngqo, unokubona ukuba a₆=1, kodwa olo lulwazi olwahlukileyo).
z-m-20-05.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi ufumene isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga eliyipheyiri nesixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba. Khetha umgca omnye ongalunganga.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.0: Susa intetho enoku-x=−1 efakiweyo kwintetho enoku-x=1 efakiweyo, uze ubone ngqo ukuba ngawaphi amalungu aseleyo nangawaphi anyamalalayo.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga iikoyifishenti ezingaphambi kwamalungu aseleyo uzithelekise nesixa ofuna ukusifumana.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.3: Ukudibanisa izilingano ezimbini kunika 2(a₆+a₄+a₂+a₀)=0, ngoko isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga eliyipheyiri singu-0.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.line.4: Ukususa izilingano ezimbini kunika ukuba isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba yi-(−1)−1=−2.
z-m-20-05.s.s2.explain: Umgca wesi-5 awulunganga. Ukususa ulingano lwesibini kolokuqala kunika 2(a₅+a₃+a₁)=−1−1=−2, ngoko isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba singu-−1. Imigca 1 ukuya kwesi-4 ilungile. Amalungu ezinga eliyipheyiri aquka ilungu eliqhelekileyo a₀.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.prompt: Kwintetho yekyubhu Q(x)=ax³+bx²+cx+d (a, b, c, d ziiinteger, a≠0), yenza ii-Q ezintathu ezahlukeneyo apho isixa seekoyifishenti zonke singu-0 kwaye isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba singu-2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.0: Kuqala khetha a ukuze isixa seekoyifishenti ezimbini zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba sibe ngu-2, emva koko fanisa c.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.hint.1: Emva koko bala ukuba isixa seekoyifishenti ezimbini eziseleyo b no-d kufuneka sibe yintoni ukuze isixa seekoyifishenti zonke sibe ngu-0.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c1: Ukuba a ingu-0, ayiyiyo intetho yekyubhu.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.ok.c4: Isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba singu-2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.fail.c4: Isixa seekoyifishenti zamalungu ezinga elingqabangqaba (x³, x) asingu-2.
z-m-20-05.s.s3.explain: Umzekelo, i-x³+x−2 inesixa seekoyifishenti 1+1−2=0 kwaye isixa seekoyifishenti zezinga elingqabangqaba yi-1+1=2. I-2x³−x²−1 nayo inesixa esingu-0 nesixa sezinga elingqabangqaba esingu-2. Zikho iintetho zekyubhu ezininzi ezinamacandelo amabini olwazi afanayo.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.prompt: Ii-Q ezahlukeneyo owazenza kwi-s3 zonke zinamacandelo amabini olwazi afanayo (isixa seekoyifishenti singu-0, isixa sezinga elingqabangqaba singu-2). Bhala isizathu sokuba la macandelo mabini olwazi wodwa angawulungisi intetho yekyubhu ibe nye, uze uqikelele ubhale ukuba kufuneka ntoni ngakumbi ukuyilungisa ibe nye.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.0: Hlela kwitheyibhile ukuba zeziphi phakathi kwe-a, b, c, d ezahlukileyo phakathi kwee-Q owazenzayo.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.hint.1: Bala inani leekoyifishenti nenani lezilingano ezivela kwiimeko ezimbini, uze uzithelekise.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.placeholder: Umzekelo: Zikho iikoyifishenti ezi-... kodwa ulwazi ...
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Ngaba uthelekise wabhala ukuba zingaphi iikoyifishenti nokuba zingaphi iinxalenye zolwazi (izilingano)?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ngaba usebenzise ii-Q ezahlukeneyo owazenzayo njengobungqina?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uyibize ngegama ulwazi olongezelelweyo olufunekayo ngomzekelo othile (umzekelo, ixabiso le-Q(2) okanye ixabiso le-a)?
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.0: Zikho iikoyifishenti ezine a, b, c, d, kodwa zikho izilingano ezimbini kuphela, a+b+c+d=0 kunye ne-a+c=2. Ngoko ukuba ulungisa a, c iyalandela, kwaye b no-d kuphela isixa sazo silungisiwe, ngoko zinokuba ninzi, njenge-x³+x−2 kunye ne-2x³−x²−1. Sifuna izilingano ezimbini ezongezelelweyo.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.model.1: Ulwazi lizixa ezimbini, ngoko ikoyifishenti nganye ayilungiswanga. Umzekelo, ukuba a=1 ngoko c=1, kwaye ukuba a=2 ngoko c=0, ngoko kuphuma iintetho ezahlukeneyo. Sifuna iimeko ezongezelelweyo, ezifana nexabiso le-Q(2) okanye ixabiso le-a, kwaye nangoko enye ifuneka ukulungisa b no-d.
z-m-20-05.s.s4.modelNote.1: Le yimpendulo ekhankanya nokuba isixa sika-b no-d kuphela silungisiwe.

z-m-20-03.title: Ukuyila ibinzana lebanga lesi-4 eliyimveliso yamabinzana amane alungeleyo
z-m-20-03.topic: Ukwenza iifaktha nokuyila amabinzana ebanga lesi-4 usebenzisa ukutshintshisa
z-m-20-03.goal: Thelekisa amacebo okwahlula ibinzana lebanga lesi-4 elineqela eliphindwayo, yila amabinzana ayimveliso yamabinzana amane alungeleyo wena, uze uchaze ukuba kutheni imiqathango iyafuneka.
z-m-20-03.material: Ibinzana (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 linokubhalwa njengemveliso yamabinzana amane alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele (ukufunda: isikwere sika-x isikwere kunye no-x, ukususa i-8 iphindwe ngo-x isikwere kunye no-x, kunye ne-12). Kulungile ukuba ibinzana elilungeleyo elifanayo liphindwe. Phakathi kwamabinzana afanayo (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n (m no-n ngamanani apheleleyo), sifuna ukufumana ezinye ezingemveliso yamabinzana amane alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.thinking.0: Ukukhetha ezivumelekileyo phakathi kwamacebo amaninzi esisombululo
z-m-20-03.prereq.1: Ukwenza iifaktha zamabinzana e-quadratic okwimilo ye-x²+px+q (ucinga ngesixa nemveliso)
z-m-20-03.prereq.2: Amava okutshintshisa iqela ngoonobumba abanye ukujonga ibinzana
z-m-20-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke amacebo anokuqhutyelwa ukuya esiphelweni ukubhala ibinzana elinikiweyo (x²+x)²−8(x²+x)+12 njengemveliso yamabinzana alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.0: Landela icebo ngalinye umgca omnye okanye emibini ujonge ukuba amabinzana amane alungeleyo ayavela esiphelweni na.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.hint.1: Xa usebenzisa indlela yokufaka amaxabiso ambalwa ukujonga, cinga ukuba uluhlu lwamaxabiso avavanyiweyo luyanela na nokuba kuthetha ntoni ukuba i-0 ayiphumanga.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.a: Faka amanani apheleleyo athile kwi-x, kwaye ukuba i-0 ayiphumi, nqumela ukuba ayinakwahlulwa
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.a: Ugqibe ukuba ayinakwahlulwa ngenxa nje yokuba i-0 ayiphumanga kumaxabiso ambalwa. Usenokuba uphosile umgqatswa, okanye uphosile ukuba inokwahlulwa ibe ngamabinzana e-quadratic kunokuba abe lungeleyo.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.b: Tshintshisa x²+x ngonobumba omnye uyiwahlule ngokufana nebinzana le-quadratic, uze ujonge kwakhona amabinzana amabini avelayo
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.b: Lelicebo lokuphatha iqela eliphindwayo njengelinye nokusombulula ngamanyathelo.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.c: Bhala (x−2)(x−6) uyinike njengempendulo ngaphandle kokufaka x²+x endaweni ye-x
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.c: Uphosile ukuba x²+x kufuneka ingene endaweni yeqela. Jonga ukuba yeyiphi indawo efuna ukubuyiselwa ukuze ibinzana le-quadratic elinonobumba omnye liphume lilibinzana elifanayo nelokuqala.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.o.d: Wandisa onke amakhonkco abe libinzana lebanga lesi-4, uze ufake abahluli be-12 uqale ngabo abanika i-0
z-m-20-03.s.s1.r.d: Lelicebo lokuvavanya ngokucwangcisekileyo abagqatswa beefaktha kwibinzana elandisiweyo.
z-m-20-03.s.s1.explain: Zombini b no-d zinokuqhutyelwa ukuya esiphelweni. b iyahlula ibe yinto efana ne-(A−2)(A−6), emva koko ibuyisele A=x²+x kwaye iphinde yahlula, kwaye d iyayisombulula njengebinzana lebanga lesi-4 ifumane iifaktha enye enye ngethiyori yefaktha. a ayivavanyanga bonke abagqatswa, kwaye c ayibuyisanga unobumba.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ubhanxa ababini abahlukileyo abapheleleyo (m, n) apho (x²+x)²+m(x²+x)+n iyimveliso yamabinzana amane alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele. Noko ke, n ayingu-0, kwaye ungafaki (m, n)=(−8, 12) engentla.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.0: Phatha x²+x njengonobumba omnye, khetha p no-q ukuze ithathe imilo (loo nobumba−p)(loo nobumba−q), uze emva koko ufumane m=−(p+q) no-n=pq.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kwi-p ne-q oyikhethileyo, jonga ngokwahlukileyo ukuba x²+x−p no-x²+x−q nganye iyahlula ibe ngamabinzana amabini alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda uthathe m no-n njengamanani apheleleyo.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Ibinzana le-quadratic eliphatha x²+x njengonobumba omnye lanelisa umqathango we-discriminant wokuba nezingcambu ezipheleleyo.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ibinzana le-quadratic eliphatha x²+x njengonobumba omnye aliwahluli libe ngamabinzana amabini alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Eli binzana le-quadratic liyahlula libe ngamabinzana amabini anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Eli binzana le-quadratic aliwahluli libe ngamabinzana amabini anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Amabinzana amabini ahlukanisiweyo ayaphinda ahlule abe ngamabinzana alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Ubuncinane elinye kumabinzana amabini avela ekwahluleni kokuqala aliwahluli ngakumbi libe ngamabinzana amabini alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba (m, n)=(−14, 24), ngoko (x²+x−2)(x²+x−12)=(x+2)(x−1)(x+4)(x−3), kwaye ukuba (−18, 72), ngoko (x²+x−6)(x²+x−12)=(x+3)(x−2)(x+4)(x−3). Ukuba (−4, 4), ngoko (x²+x−2)²=(x+2)²(x−1)². (−5, 6) iyahlula ibe yi-(x²+x−2)(x²+x−3), kodwa x²+x−3 ayiwahluli ngakumbi ibe ngamabinzana alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.prompt: Ukuba (m, n)=(−4, 3), iyahlula ibe yi-(x²+x−3)(x²+x−1). Ingaba x²+x−3 phakathi kwazo iyaphinda yahlule ibe yimveliso yamabinzana amabini alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele? Phendula "iyahlula" okanye "ayihluli" ubhale isizathu.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.0: Vumela x²+x−3=(x+u)(x+v) ubhale ukuba ikoyefishenti ye-x negama eliqhubekayo liphuma njani ngo-u no-v xa ulandisa icala lasekunene.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.hint.1: Lungelelanisa bonke ubhanxa abaphelele abaneemveliso ezi-−3, ufumane isixa sabo ngabanye, uze ujonge ukuba ingaba nawuphi kubo uyi-1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubhale ukuba u+v no-uv kufuneka nganye ibe yintoni xa ibhalwe kwimilo (x+u)(x+v)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ubhale ukuba ujonge amanani apheleleyo anjalo u no-v (okanye unike esinye isizathu, njenge-discriminant)?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba uthethe ukuba isigqibo esithi "ayisebenzi" sisuka ekujongeni inani labagqatswa okanye komnye umqathango?
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.0: Ayihluli. Ukuba siyibhala njenge-(x+u)(x+v), kufuneka u+v=1 no-uv=−3, kodwa ubhanxa abaphelele abaneemveliso ye-−3 yi-(1, −3) kuphela kunye ne-(−1, 3), kwaye izixa zabo zi-−2 no-2, ngoko asinakufumana i-1.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.1: Ayihluli ngakumbi ngamakoyefishenti aphelele. I-discriminant ye-x²+x−3=0 yi-1+12=13, kwaye i-13 ayisosikwere esigqibeleleyo, ngoko izingcambu azingamanani apheleleyo okanye iziqhezu, emva koko ayinakubhalwa njengemveliso yamabinzana amabini alungeleyo anamakoyefishenti aphelele.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.2: Xa p=2, kukho u=2 no-v=−1 ezinesixa se-1 nemveliso i-−2, ngoko iyahlula. Kodwa kwi-3, akukho bhanxa ophelele onemveliso i-−3 nesixa se-1, ngoko ayihluli. Ngoko kubonakala ukuba p kufuneka ibe yimveliso yamanani apheleleyo amabini alandelanayo, njenge-2, 6, 12, ukuze ihlule.
z-m-20-03.s.s3.model.3: Ayahlulwa. Ukufaka abahluli begama eliqhubekayo i-−3, 1, −1, 3, −3, akunikanga i-0.

z-m-20-04.title: Ingaba ixabiso lebinzana elifakwe inani elingenangqiqo linani elingenangqiqo?
z-m-20-04.topic: Ixabiso nesiseleyo sebinzana elifakwe inani elingenangqiqo
z-m-20-04.goal: Jonga ngokubala ukuba ixabiso lebinzana le-cubic elifakwe inani elingenangqiqo linokuba linani eliphelele, uze wenze elinye ibinzana elinexabiso eli-4 ngesizathu esifanayo.
z-m-20-04.material: Sifuna ukufumanisa ixabiso le-E=x³−3x²−3x+5 xa x=2+√3. Ukufunda: x yi-"2 kongeza ingcambu ye-3" kwaye x³ yi-"x ikyubhu". Asisebenzisi khaltyuleyitha. √3 linani lepositive isikwere salo esiyi-3, kwaye alinakubhalwa njengeqhezu. Ulwazi luvezwa ngecandelo elinye ngexesha, ngoko ngalo lonke ixesha khetha oko ucinga ukuba kufanelekile ngoku.
z-m-20-04.thinking.0: Ukuhlaziya uqikelelo lwakho lwangaphambi kokubala ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi olungakumbi luvela
z-m-20-04.prereq.3: Intsingiselo yesiphumo sokwahlula nesiseleyo xa ibinzana lahlulwa libinzana (ibinzana lokwahlula A=BQ+R)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.prompt: Ngalo lonke ixesha ulwazi luvezwa, khetha oko ucinga ngexabiso le-E.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, bhala ukuba ungaya kude kangakanani ngokubala okwaziwayo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku kuphela.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.hint.1: Vavanya izibhengezo ezinamagama athi "kufuneka" okanye "ngekhe" phakathi kokhetho ngokusebenzisa imizekelo echasayo okanye ukubala.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.info: x linani elingenangqiqo 2+√3, kwaye i-E inamagama apho x iphindaphindwe amaxesha amaninzi (x³, x²). Konke obalileyo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku yi-x²=(2+√3)²=7+4√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ukuba ixabiso le-E liya kuthatha imilo enjani?
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ungenza uqikelelo, kodwa awunasiseko sokuthi kufuneka libe lingenangqiqo. Ukuba ubala ukuya kwi-x³, uya kukwazi ukuxela.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ekubeni x ingenangqiqo, ndiphantse ndiqinisekile ukuba i-E ayinangqiqo nayo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Xa ubala ngamanani angenangqiqo, √3 inokuyekelana. Umzekelo, (1+√3)+(1−√3)=2. Kusekwangoko ukuthi "kufuneka" phambi kokubala.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ibonakala ngathi ayinangqiqo, kodwa siyazi ngokuqinisekileyo emva kokubala ukuya kwi-x³.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Onke amakoyefishenti ebinzana angamanani apheleleyo, ngoko i-E linani eliphelele ngaphandle kokubala.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Inyaniso yokuba amakoyefishenti angamanani apheleleyo ayinikezi sigqibo sifanayo nexa x linani eliphelele.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ndiyazi x² kuphela, ngoko x³ inzima ukuyifumana, kwaye ndicinga ukuba akukho nto inokuthethwa okwangoku.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ungaqhubeka nge-x³=x²×x. Ungaqhubeka ubala ngolwazi olunalo ngoku.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.info: x³=x²×x=(7+4√3)(2+√3)=26+15√3. Faka x²=7+4√3, x=2+√3, x³=26+15√3 kwi-E=x³−3x²−3x+5, uqokelele inxalenye epheleleyo nekoyefishenti ye-√3 ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Inxalenye epheleleyo yi-26−21−6+5=4 kwaye ikoyefishenti ye-√3 yi-15−12−3=0. Ngoko E=4. Nokuba ufaka inani elingenangqiqo x, ixabiso linokuba linani eliphelele, kwaye ukuba uqale waqikelela "ibonakala ingenangqiqo", kufuneka uhlaziye loo mqikelelo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ikoyefishenti ye-√3 iba yi-15−12−3=0, ngoko E linani eliphelele 4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Esi sigqibo sivela ekuqokeleleni iinxalenye ezimbini ngokwahlukileyo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Igama le-√3 liyasala, ngoko E ayinangqiqo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Awuqokelelanga onke amakoyefishenti amagama e-√3 wajonga i-15 kuphela. Bala i-15−12−3.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ikoyefishenti ye-√3 yi-0, ngoko yonke i-E yi-0.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ukunyamalala kwegama le-√3 kwahlukile ekubeni inxalenye epheleleyo yi-0. Bala nenxalenye epheleleyo i-26−21−6+5.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ekubeni x ingenangqiqo, esi siphumo sokubala asinakuthenjwa nasco.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukubala ngenani elingenangqiqo elifakiweyo kuchanekile nako. Isiphumo ukuba linani eliphelele akwenzi ukuba kungalunganga.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.info: x=2+√3 yanelisa x²−4x+1=0 (x²=7+4√3 kwaye 4x=8+4√3, ngoko x²−4x+1=0). Kwakhona, xa E ihlulwa yi-x²−4x+1, isiphumo sokwahlula yi-x+1 kwaye isiseleyo yi-4, ngoko E=(x+1)(x²−4x+1)+4 iyasebenza.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Lingaphi ixabiso ukuba ufaka x=2−√3 kwi-E? (2−√3 nayo yanelisa x²−4x+1=0. Unokujonga nangokuyifaka ngqo.)
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuba x²−4x+1=0 iyasebenza, ngoko E=(x+1)×0+4=4. 2−√3 yanelisa i-equation efanayo, ngoko ixabiso liyafana. Ukuba uyifaka ngqo, ufumana i-4 nayo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Uphawu lwe-√3 lutshintshile, ngoko uphawu lwenxalenye epheleleyo luya kutshintsha nalo kwaye iya kuba yi-−4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Igama le-√3 kuphela litshintsha uphawu. Jonga ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwinxalenye epheleleyo i-4.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ndibeke inani elahlukileyo kwi-2+√3, ngoko ixabiso elibaliweyo liya kuba lahlukile nalo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ukubeka inani elahlukileyo kusenokunika ixabiso elifanayo. Jonga indima edlalwa yi-x²−4x+1 kwintetho yokwahlula.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Andikwazi ukwazi ndide ndibeke ndibale ngqo, ngoko ndiza kubala i-x³ ne-x².
z-m-20-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Lo ngumzamo wokujonga ngqo. Ubonisa ukuba kukho ngaphezulu kwendlela enye yokufikelela kwimpendulo.
z-m-20-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni waqikelela ukuba E iya kuba ngokungaphandle kwengqiqo. Emva kokubona isiphumo sokubala, olo qikelelo lwatshintsha njani? Ulwazi lwesibini nolwesithathu lukuxelele ntoni nganye?
z-m-20-04.s.s2.prompt: Yenza iintetho ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zekyubhu x³+ax²+bx+c (a, b, c ziiinteger) apho ixabiso lingu-4 xa x=2+√3. Kodwa ke, khupha intetho ene-a=−3 (i-E engasentla).
z-m-20-04.s.s2.hint.0: Usebenzisa x³=26+15√3, x²=7+4√3, x=2+√3 kwi-x=2+√3, bhala ixabiso le-x³+ax²+bx+c ngefom (inxalenye eyiinteger)+(ikoyifishenti ye-√3)√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kuqala khetha a ukuze ikoyifishenti ye-√3 ibe ngu-0 kwaye inxalenye eyiinteger ibe ngu-4, emva koko fanisa b no-c.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Nceda uthathe a, b, c njenge-integer.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Kwixabiso elinoku-x=2+√3 efakiweyo, akukho nxalenye enamathele ne-√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kwixabiso elinoku-x=2+√3 efakiweyo, kuseleyo inxalenye enamathele ne-√3. Sebenzisa x³=26+15√3 kunye ne-x²=7+4√3 ukuqokelela ikoyifishenti ye-√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Inxalenye eyiinteger asingu-4. Qokelela iinxalenye eziiinteger uze ujonge.
z-m-20-04.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba ubeka x=2+√3 kwi-x³−15x+8, ufumana 26+15√3−30−15√3+8=4. I-x³+x²−19x+9 kunye ne-x³−2x²−7x+6 nazo zinika i-4. Zonke ezi ntetho zahluka kwi-E kuphela ngesiphindaphindi se-x²−4x+1.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.prompt: Khetha enye yeentetho oyenzileyo uze ubhale isizathu sokuba ixabiso lalo likwa-4 xa x=2−√3, hayi nje xa x=2+√3. Ungachaza ngokubala ngokubeka ngqo, okanye ungachaza usebenzisa i-x²−4x+1.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.hint.0: Kwintetho oyikhethileyo, fumana i-x³, x², kunye ne-x ku-x=2−√3 uze ubhale nganye yahlulwe ibe yinxalenye eyiinteger kunye nenxalenye ye-√3.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.hint.1: Thelekisa nokubala owakusebenzisayo kwi-x=2+√3 uze ufumane amalungu apho uphawu kuphela lutshintshile.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ubhale iikoyifishenti zentetho oyikhethileyo ngokukhethekileyo?
z-m-20-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uchaze isizathu sokuba ikwasebenza ku-x=2−√3, usebenzisa ukubala okanye iphropati efana ne-x²−4x+1=0?
z-m-20-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba uthethe ngokwahlukileyo ukuba inxalenye eyiinteger engu-4 nenxalenye ye-√3 engu-0 yaphuma njani nganye?
z-m-20-04.s.s3.model.0: Kwi-x³−15x+8, xa x=2−√3, x²=7−4√3 kwaye x³=26−15√3, ngoko 26−15√3−15(2−√3)+8=4. Ii-−15√3 kunye ne-+15√3 ezinamathele ku-√3 ziyarhoxisana, kwaye inxalenye eyiinteger yi-26−30+8=4.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.model.1: Le ntetho inokubhalwa ngefom (x−4)(x²−4x+1)+4. Zombini i-2+√3 kunye ne-2−√3 zanelisa i-x²−4x+1=0, ngoko inxalenye yokuqala iba ngu-0 kwaye i-4 kuphela eseleyo.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.model.2: Ekubeni x²=4x−1, x³=4x²−x=15x−4. Xa ndiyibeka kwintetho yam, inxalenye engenanto yakwenza ne-√3 ilungiswe njenge-4, ngoko nokuba yeyiphi ixabiso endiyibeka kuyo x, yi-4 efanayo.
z-m-20-04.s.s3.modelNote.2: Yindlela yokwehlisa izinga ngokusebenzisa ngokuphindaphindiweyo x²=4x−1.
